text_block_list.name: Kurumi
text_block_list.text: Th-there are a lot of small mice! They keep coming out one after another!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ち、
小さいネズミたちがたくさん！
後から後から出てきますぅ！

text_block_list.name: Chuuji
text_block_list.text: Hehehe... The power to support my mouse family... That is quantity...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
クックック……
我がネズミ一家を支える力……
それは
数だ……！

text_block_list.name: Misaki
text_block_list.text: Hey!! 1, 2, 3... How many are there!? I didn't hear that so many of them would come out!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょっとー！！
１、
２、
３……
何匹いるのよ！？
こんなにたくさん出てくるなんて聞いてないわよ！

text_block_list.name: Kurumi
text_block_list.text: A-anyway! We seem to have no choice but to defeat them one by one.
text_block_list.orig_text:
と、
とにかく！　
片っ端からやっつけるしか
なさそうですぅ！

text_block_list.name: Misaki
text_block_list.text: It's hopeless to do it bit by bit. Let's clean them all up at once!
text_block_list.orig_text:
地道にやっても埒が明かないわ。
一気に片づけちゃいましょ！

text_block_list.name: Misaki
text_block_list.text: Now, are you ready? Let's go!
text_block_list.orig_text:
さぁ、
覚悟はいいわね！？
行くわよ！
